name: Efka Engineering System

components.purpose: readiness of toolchain, agent surfaces, MCP, repos, secret files, disk
one-command production gate with JSON/TXT logs and 60-run retention
high-confidence credential scan by filename and content
new project with AGENTS.md, .gitignore, .gitattributes, check.ps1, git baseline
inventory, skill catalog, MCP, memory rules, roadmap, foundations, toolchain

invariants: no credential values in the repository; configuration reads them from environment variables
one authoritative copy; installs are generated from this repository
every check is read-only and returns a meaningful exit code
unsupported capability means BLOCKED, never a silent fallback

adapters.description: Host-specific layers live outside core/ and are never copied into other machines.
adapters.example: adapters/<name>/verify.ps1 is executed automatically by the gate when present
